scopeId.description: Id of the workspace, project, or session the binding is pinned to. In the `agent` and `area` scopes, which exist PER PROJECT, it is composite: `<projectId>:<agent slug|area key>` (ADR 0064).

routingPreference.description: How a hub picks the upstream for this binding (ADR 0166, RN-583). `null` = the hub decides on its own. Only ever set for a provider that declares the `routingPreference` capability.

400.description: Invalid body. The `ValidationPipe` runs with `whitelist` and `forbidNonWhitelisted`, so an unknown field also fails.

401.description: No token, expired token, or invalid signature.

429.description: Rate limit per user or per IP.
